results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Fixed the ends_with and starts_with functions in jmespath/functions.py by swapping their incorrect implementations. The ends_with function was using startswith and starts_with was using endswith. After correcting them, all function-related compliance tests pass.

results.name: click-intrange-clamp
results.summary: Fixed the `_clamp` method in `IntRange` (src/click/types.py) to correctly handle open bounds when clamping: changed `return bound - dir` to `return bound + dir`. This makes `IntRange(0, min_open=True, clamp=True)` convert '0' to 1 as expected. All tests in `tests/test_types/test_IntRange.py` now pas

results.name: jinja-batch-filter
results.summary: Fixed the batch filter in src/jinja2/filters.py by changing the condition from `len(tmp) > linecount` to `len(tmp) >= linecount`. This ensures that batches are yielded when the temporary list reaches the exact linecount, preventing extra items in the last batch. The test test_batch now passes and al

results.name: packaging-canonicalize
results.summary: Fixed canonicalize_name to replace '.' and '_' with '-' and condense repeated '-', making it compliant with PEP 503. Verified by running the test suite and checking the specific example.

results.name: pyparsing-lineno
results.summary: Fixed off-by-one line number reporting in pyparsing.util.lineno by adding 1 to the count of newlines before the given location. This makes the first line number 1 instead of 0. All unit tests now pass.

results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed the parsing of \\uXXXX escape sequences in basic strings by changing the hex length from 3 to 4 in parse_basic_str_escape. All tests now pass.
